name: El Chingon
notes: Photos 1 and 2 are two revisions of the same printed menu board with different prices/sections (photo 2 is newer/more complete: adds Fusion, Molcajete, Pork Belly, Tomahawk Steak; drops Tortas and a few starters). Used photo 2 as primary and merged in items unique to photo 1 (Queso Fundido, Cóctel de Camarones, Ceviche Tostada, Chicharrones El Chingón, Baja Street Cart Fruit Salad, Tortas section) that don't conflict. Photo 3 is a rum list only, skipped. Prices that vary by quantity/protein (Rolled Tacos, Quesabirria Empanada, Wings, Bad Ass Fajitas) had price omitted.
